name: bb-plugin-e-corp
description: A cold corporate workstation theme for bb.

scripts.build: npm run build:theme && bb plugin build
scripts.check: npm run build:theme && bb plugin types --check && npm run typecheck && bb plugin build

bb.name: E Corp
bb.description: Adds a cold corporate workstation palette with matching code, diff, file-tree, and terminal colors.

themes.name: E Corp
themes.description: Petroleum blue surfaces, restrained cyan illumination, steel dividers, and matching syntax colors.
